title: Parrot
subtagline: Parrot pulls every conversation — Instagram, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, X, Telegram, Discord — into one inbox with AI drafts that sound like you.
bigStatement: Every unreplied DM is a missed fan, a lost deal, or a relationship that went cold.

valueProps.title: Your inbox is a graveyard.
valueProps.description: Messages scattered across 6 apps, some weeks old. Parrot pulls everything into one screen so nothing slips through.

valueProps.title: Reply in seconds, not minutes.
valueProps.description: Parrot drafts a reply in your voice using conversation context. You tweak it, hit send, move on.

valueProps.title: Know who matters. Act on it.
valueProps.description: Tracks interactions across platforms — who's engaged, who's going cold — so you know where to spend energy.

audienceSections.title: Creators & Influencers
points: Past 50K followers, you can't keep up with DMs. Parrot gives you drafts, context, and smart suggestions to reply to 100 DMs in the time it takes for 10.
Auto-handle the repetitive questions. Give your real attention to the conversations that matter.

audienceSections.title: Founders
points: Every DM could be a customer, investor, or hire. Parrot drafts replies in your voice and flags high-value conversations with a CRM view of every relationship.
Stop losing warm leads to slow replies.

audienceSections.title: Community & Sales
points: Kanban workflow (Unread → In Progress → Done) with batch reply tools and full conversation history across platforms.
Move through hundreds of messages without dropping context or letting anyone slip through.

featureSections.headline: Your voice. Zero effort.
featureSections.description: Parrot learns how you actually write — your slang, your emoji habits, your tone. It drafts replies that sound like you, not a chatbot.

featureSections.headline: Everything you need. Before you ask.
featureSections.description: Open a conversation and the context is already there: full history, who this person is, what you last talked about, and a suggested reply ready to go.

featureSections.headline: Your network. Organized.
featureSections.description: Every contact across every platform — organized in one CRM with AI-extracted context so you never forget who someone is or what you talked about.

featureSections.headline: Six apps. One screen.
featureSections.description: Stop checking WhatsApp, then Instagram, then LinkedIn every morning. Parrot pulls everything into one view — threaded, searchable, and organized.

features.title: Voice Drafts
features.description: Replies that sound like you wrote them. Review, tweak, and send.

features.title: Smart Context
features.description: Conversation history and contact info surfaced when you open a thread.

features.title: Unified Inbox
features.description: Every platform in one view. No more tab-switching.

features.title: Engagement Tracking
features.description: See who's a superfan, who's slipping away, and who needs a reply.

features.title: 10+ Platforms
features.description: WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, Discord, LinkedIn, X, and more.

features.title: Kanban Workflow
features.description: Drag conversations: Unread → In Progress → Done.

closingCta.headline: Stop ghosting your audience.
closingCta.subheadline: Parrot is in alpha for macOS. Get early access.
